verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents headless automation directly. The pscale CLI offers non-interactive SQL "for agents and scripts" and can create, delete and list databases and branches. Service tokens authenticate the hosted MCP server "in CI, headless agents", and a programmatic API and Terraform support are also documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and explicit docs for CLI/API service-token auth in CI pipelines (the CI-auth doc covers the MCP server specifically).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Run non-interactive SQL for agents and scripts (`pscale sql`)
Use a PlanetScale service token to authenticate the hosted MCP server in CI, headless agents, and clients that send a custom HTTP header
Create, delete and list your Vitess, Neki, and Postgres databases and branches
The PlanetScale API allows you to manage your PlanetScale databases programmatically.
